title: Column and Case — minimalist black-and-white marketing site

requirements.summary: Build a responsive multi-section marketing site for “Column and Case” with a clean black/white aesthetic.
acceptanceCriteria: Site name “Column and Case” is prominently displayed in the header and page title
All pages/sections use a strictly black/white/gray palette (no color accents)
Layout is minimal with ample whitespace and consistent spacing across breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop)

file_operations.description: Create the main single-page marketing layout with a header (prominent “Column and Case”), hero, and required sections; ensure responsive spacing and structure across breakpoints.
Verify the document title is set to “Column and Case” and language is English; keep metadata minimal and aligned with the monochrome brand.
Add a reusable layout wrapper providing centered container width, consistent section spacing, and a minimal black/white background treatment.

requirements.summary: Add top navigation for Home, Collection, About, Contact with a mobile-friendly menu and current-section indication.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can access Home, Collection, About, and Contact from a top navigation (desktop) and a mobile-friendly menu (mobile)
Navigation clearly indicates the current page/section
All navigation items work without console errors

file_operations.description: Implement a responsive header with desktop nav links and a mobile menu toggle; include active-state styling for the current section.
Add a lightweight hook to track the currently visible section (e.g., via IntersectionObserver) to drive the navigation active indicator.
Wire SiteHeader into the page and ensure nav links scroll to the correct sections (Home/Collection/About/Contact) without console errors.

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive Collection product grid with at least 8 placeholder menswear items (image, name, price).
acceptanceCriteria: Collection grid renders at least 8 products with consistent card layout
Each product card shows an image, name, and price in English
Grid is responsive (1 column on small screens, increasing on larger screens)

file_operations.description: Create placeholder product data (at least 8 items) with English names/prices and image paths pointing to the generated product images in frontend/public/assets/generated (cc-product-01.dim_800x1000.png through cc-product-08.dim_800x1000.png).
Build the Collection section with a clean, consistent product card grid; use responsive Tailwind classes to scale from 1 column on small screens upward.
Wire the CollectionSection into the main page and ensure it is reachable via navigation and section anchors.

requirements.summary: Add an About section with short, restrained English editorial copy describing Column and Case.
acceptanceCriteria: About content is in English and references “Column and Case”
Typography is readable and consistent with the minimalist theme
Section is accessible via navigation

file_operations.description: Create an About section with minimalist editorial typography, short English copy referencing “Column and Case”, and clean spacing suitable for the monochrome theme.
Wire the AboutSection into the main page with an anchor target so navigation can reach it reliably.

requirements.summary: Add a Contact section with a simple contact form UI and a clean footer with basic brand links.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form includes fields for name, email, and message and a submit button
Submitting the form shows a clear on-screen confirmation (no external email integration required)
Footer includes brand name and at least 2 links (e.g., Collection, About)

file_operations.description: Implement the Contact section with a local-only form UI (name, email, message) and an on-screen submission confirmation state (no external integrations).
Create a minimal footer in black/white with the brand name and at least two internal links (e.g., Collection, About) that scroll to their sections.
Wire ContactSection and SiteFooter into the page and ensure footer links work without console errors.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive minimalist black-and-white design system across typography, spacing, borders, buttons, inputs, and hover states.
acceptanceCriteria: Buttons/links/inputs share a consistent style system (e.g., thin borders, subtle hover inversion)
No bright colors are introduced; only black/white/grays are used
Overall styling looks intentionally minimalist (not default browser styling)

file_operations.description: Add global Tailwind layers and a monochrome design baseline (CSS variables or utility patterns) ensuring only black/white/grays are used; define consistent focus/hover states and typography defaults.
Confirm Tailwind theme supports monochrome tokens (background/foreground/border) and adjust defaults if needed to avoid color accents; keep typography and spacing coherent.
Ensure layout-level spacing scale, section separators (thin borders), and consistent container widths are applied uniformly across all sections.

requirements.summary: Render generated static brand images from frontend/public/assets/generated directly in the React UI (no backend fetching).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the React UI
At least a logo/wordmark and a hero image are visibly used on the site
No backend endpoints are used for serving these images

file_operations.description: Reference and render the wordmark image directly from frontend/public/assets/generated/column-and-case-wordmark.dim_1200x400.png in the header/brand area (no backend usage).
Create a hero section that visibly uses the generated hero banner image frontend/public/assets/generated/column-and-case-hero.dim_2400x1200.png and includes restrained English headline/subcopy.

Ensure each of the 8 placeholder products references a distinct generated image: frontend/public/assets/generated/cc-product-01.dim_800x1000.png through frontend/public/assets/generated/cc-product-08.dim_800x1000.png, used directly by the UI.
Wire HeroSection into the top of the page and ensure all generated images are displayed via direct static paths (no backend calls).
